name: Advent Together

persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Linda, 66, a Sunday school helper at Grace Community Church in Illinois. Your pastor wants every family to use this app in December, and you will also use it at home with your husband, Tom, and your grandson, Sam. Today, in October, you are getting everything ready before December comes.

challenge.intro: Now you are Linda from Grace Community Church. It is October, so the doors are still locked and stars cannot be earned yet. Your job is to get the app ready for December. Nobody will tell you which button to press: use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Use the NORMAL app link (not the 🧪 test copy). Open Advent Together. If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. (This app is not in the house erase list, so there is no 🧹 Start fresh link at the bottom. Empty it by hand instead.) Then: 1) scroll to 'Our family' and delete everything in the box 'Who’s doing Advent together?'; 2) tap '⛪ Open the church kit', delete anything in 'Your church’s name', and close it with ✕; 3) open '⚙️ Settings' at the bottom and make sure 'Bigger type' and 'Preview mode' are both OFF.

tasks.text: At home you will do Advent with your husband, Tom, and your grandson, Sam. Put them in, so their names appear on every day's reading.
tasks.hint: Look for the card called 'Our family'. Both names go in the same box.

tasks.text: Your pastor wants to print the paper with all 24 readings for the church. Make sure it shows your church's name: Grace Community Church.
tasks.hint: The church's name is not the family box. Look in the card 'For churches'.

tasks.text: You teach Sunday school, and you want to read the December readings NOW, in October, so you can prepare. Make the app open every door for you before its day.
tasks.hint: This is a choice for pastors and teachers. It is at the very bottom of the page, in this app's own Settings.

tasks.text: Tom cannot read small words on a phone. Make the words in this app bigger for him.
tasks.hint: Use this app's own Settings at the bottom of the page (not the ? help button).

personaChurch.title: Pretend you are…
personaChurch.text: Pretend you are Pastor Linda, 61, of Grace Community Church in Illinois. You want every family to use this app in December, and you will use it at home too, with your husband, Tom, and your grandson, Sam. Today, in October, you get everything ready before December comes.

introChurch: Now you are Pastor Linda of Grace Community Church. It is October, so the doors are still locked and stars cannot be earned yet. Your job is to get the app ready for December. Nobody will tell you which button to press: use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains Advent Together: what it is for, and how to use it.
First, one word. Advent means the four weeks before Christmas, when Christians get ready to celebrate the birth of Jesus.
Many families want to pray and read the Bible together in Advent. But December is busy, and a good plan is forgotten after three days.
Advent Together makes it simple. Every day from the first of December to the twenty-fourth, it gives a family one short Bible reading, one prayer, and one small thing to do together.
It is for families, grandparents with grandchildren, and whole churches reading the same door on the same day.
Everything is on one long page. You just scroll down.
The first time you open it, a welcome card explains the app. Tap Let's begin and it goes away.
At the top is the big card. Before December, it counts the days until Advent begins.
Before December, tap Try the Day 1 sample to see what a day looks like. From the first of December, this card shows today's door.
Next is the Advent wreath. One more candle is lit each Sunday: Hope, Peace, Joy and Love, and the white Christ candle on Christmas Eve. The app lights them by itself.
Then the twenty-four doors, one for each day before Christmas. A lock means the door is not open yet. It opens on its own day.
Tap a locked door, and a note tells you when it opens. The Today button jumps to today's door, or before December, to the Day 1 sample.
After door twenty-four comes a Christmas Day page, which opens on December the twenty-fifth.
Inside a door, the top shows the day, the date, and a short title.
Then the Bible verse, from the King James Bible. Then Think about it: a few plain words on what the verse means.
For the little ones is a line for children. Pray together is a short prayer. Do this together today is one small, kind thing, like calling someone who lives alone.
When your family has done it, tap We did it. Your family gets a star for that day, and the app counts how many days in a row you have done.
Stars only start on December the first, because each star belongs to its own day.
Read it aloud reads the whole day to the family. Share sends the day by text or email, to someone far away.
Close a door with the X at the top.
Further down is Our family. Type the names of the people doing Advent with you, and their names appear on every day's reading.
Below the names are your stars out of twenty-four, and your days in a row.
Then For churches. Tap Open the church kit, and a church leader types the church's name.
The kit makes a one-page bulletin insert with all twenty-four readings, ready to print, and a Sunday announcement to copy. Nothing in the kit is sent anywhere.
At the bottom is Settings. Bigger type makes the words larger. Preview mode, for pastors and teachers, opens every door now so you can read ahead. Stars still only come on the real day.
How to start: try the Day 1 sample, type your family's names, and if you lead a church, open the church kit. Then come back on the first of December.
Everything stays on this phone. There is no account, and nothing to sign up for. Advent Together is seven dollars for a family, or forty-nine dollars for a whole church.
And when you open the app itself, the question mark button in the bottom corner has the tour and help any time.

daily.task: Open today’s card in Advent Together and mark it done — or add a short note to any day.

explore.name: 🕯 Top · countdown · wreath
explore.try: Read the countdown. Look at the wreath and the four Sundays. Look at Share — don’t send.

explore.name: 📅 Today & the doors
explore.find: Tap Today, then scroll to the doors.
explore.try: Tap Today. Tap a locked door. Tap the Christmas door.

explore.name: 📖 Inside a door
explore.try: Read the verse. Tap Read it aloud, then stop it. Look at Share — don’t send. Close with ✕.

explore.name: 👪 Your family
explore.try: Type names (try a very long one and emoji). Look at your stars.

explore.name: ⛪ The church kit
explore.try: Type a church name. Tap Print (cancel). Copy the announcement.

explore.name: ⚙️ Settings
explore.try: Try bigger type and Preview mode, then put them back.
